title: Shape Distillation Requested v1
description: User requests CHIT distillation — building a model or configuration tuned to their discovered shape. Always user-initiated. The system may suggest readiness but never auto-triggers.

user_id.description: Unique identifier for the human body requesting distillation

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the distillation request

shape_version.description: Shape profile version to distill from — ties to profile.updated.v1 shape_version

distillation_type.description: What kind of distillation to perform

target_agent_id.description: Optional — distill for a specific agent (default: all preferred agents)

trace_window_days.description: Optional — only use traces from the last N days (default: all available traces)

custom_constraints.description: Optional user-defined constraints for the distillation (e.g., max token budget, excluded domains, temperature bounds)
